title: Negotiating and persuading / Kotsala na kosala makasi
bridge: Na español, po na kosala makasi tozali kosala na mikakatí ya mokolo moko lokola 'deberías' to 'tienes que', mpe na subjuntivo na mikakatí ya 'para que'. Na anglais, B2 ezali na bosongi ya kozala na ndembo moke mpe malamu, kozala na 'would', 'could', 'might' mpe 'I was wondering if...'. Boye mpe na kozonga 'hacer una contraoferta' lokola 'to make a counteroffer' (ezali ya solo) kasi kotika 'to suggest' ezali na bosongi ya kozala na base ya verbe (suggest + infinitive) kasi te na subjuntivo. Mpe 'tag questions' po na kozala na accord (isn't it?) ezali te ya moko na '¿no?', pamba te na anglais ezali na kobatela na auxiliaire ya mikakatí ya mokolo moko.
rule: Po na kotsala na kosala makasi na anglais B2, tozali kozala na: 1) Verbes modaux po na kopesa ndembo: 'would' (I would appreciate...), 'could' (Could we...), 'might' (That might work). 2) Mikakatí ya malamu: 'I was wondering if...', 'Would it be possible to...?', 'If you could..., that would be...'. 3) Mikakatí po na kopesa makambo: 'That's a fair point, but...', 'I see what you mean, however...'. 4) Mikakatí po na kosala accord: 'What if we...?', 'How about...? + -ing', 'Would you be open to...?'. 5) Condicional po na mikakatí ya hypothese: 'If we lowered the price, would you buy two?' (condicional ya liboso). Po na kosala makasi, tozali kozala na mikakatí lokola 'Think of it this way...', 'The way I see it...', 'It's worth considering that...'. Ya solo: na anglais, 'suggest' mpe 'recommend' tozali kozala na that + sujet + verbe na base (te na 's'), to na gerundif: 'I suggest that we wait' / 'I suggest waiting'. Tozali kozala te na subjuntivo lokola na español.

concept_examples.text: Could we possibly meet halfway on the price?
concept_examples.translation: Tosengeli kopesa mokolo moke na nzela ya prix?
concept_examples.phonetic: /kʊd wi ˈpɒsəbli miːt ˌhæfˈweɪ ɒn ðə praɪs/

concept_examples.text: I was wondering if you might consider a discount for bulk orders.
concept_examples.translation: Nazali koyeba soki tozali kosala mokano ya kopesa likebi po na biloko mingi.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ wɒz ˈwʌndərɪŋ ɪf ju maɪt kənˈsɪdər ə dɪskaʊnt fɔː bʌlk ˈɔːrdərz/

concept_examples.text: What if we extend the deadline by a week? That could work for both of us.
concept_examples.translation: Mpe soki tozali kopesa mokolo moke ya liboso, ezali kokoka na bosongi ya biso mibali?
concept_examples.phonetic: /wɒt ɪf wi ɪkˈstend ðə dedlaɪn baɪ ə wiːk ðæt kʊd wɜːrk fɔːr boʊθ əv ʌs/

concept_examples.text: If you agree to a lower price, we'll sign the contract today.
concept_examples.translation: Soki ozali kopesa prix moke, tozali kobima contrat lelo.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf ju əˈɡriː tʊ ə loʊər praɪs wiːl saɪn ðə ˈkɒntrækt təˈdeɪ/

common_error.wrong: I suggest that we should wait until next week.
common_error.correct: I suggest that we wait until next week.
common_error.correct_alt: I suggest waiting until next week.
common_error.explanation: Likolo ezali na kozala na mikakatí ya español 'sugiero que debamos esperar' na verbe 'should'. Na anglais, na noko ya 'suggest' (mpe 'recommend', 'propose'), tozali kozala na subjuntivo ya anglais, ozali na base ya verbe (te na 's' mpe te na 'should'). Tosengeli kozala na mikakatí ya gerundif lokola alternative. Ezali ya solo na kozala na mokolo ya kozala na español; na anglais tozali kozala na base ya verbe po na biso nionso, ata po na 'he/she/it'.

levels.label: Softening requests and proposals
levels.translation: Kopesa ndembo na mikakatí mpe mikombo

examples.original: Would it be possible to get an extension?
examples.phonetic: /wʊd ɪt bi ˈpɒsəbl tə ɡet ən ɪkˈstenʃən/
examples.translation: Ezali kokoka na kopesa mokano moke?
examples.note: Tozali kozala na 'would' na noko ya 'will' po na kozala na malamu, lokola '¿Podría?' na español.

examples.original: I was wondering if you could lower the price.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wɒz ˈwʌndərɪŋ ɪf ju kʊd ˈloʊər ðə praɪs/
examples.translation: Nazali koyeba soki tozali kosala mokano ya kopesa prix moke.
examples.note: Mikakatí ya 'I was wondering if...' ezali ya mokolo moko na kotsala. Kozala te na 'I wondered' ozali na bosongi ya kozala na mokolo moko.

examples.original: Could we possibly agree on a different payment schedule?
examples.phonetic: /kʊd wi ˈpɒsəbli əˈɡriː ɒn ə ˈdɪfrənt ˈpeɪmənt ˈʃedjuːl/
examples.translation: Tosengeli kopesa mokano moke ya kozala na calendrier ya kopesa mbongo moke?
examples.note: 'Possibly' ezali na kopesa malamu moke. Na español tozali koyeba '¿Podríamos quizás?', kasi 'possibly' ezali na kozala na noko ya sujet.

examples.original: That's a fair point, but we can't go below ten percent.
examples.phonetic: /ðæts ə feər pɔɪnt bʌt wi kænt ɡəʊ bɪˈloʊ ten pəˈsent/
examples.translation: Ezali mokano moke, kasi tozali kozala na kopesa mokano ya kopesa mokano ya mokuse.
examples.note: Kozala na mokano ya moke ('That's a fair point') ezali ya solo na noko ya kozala na mokano moke.

examples.original: If you agree to a longer contract, we could offer a better rate.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf ju əˈɡriː tʊ ə ˈlɒŋɡər ˈkɒntrækt wi kʊd ˈɒfər ə ˈbetər reɪt/
examples.translation: Soki ozali kopesa contrat ya mokolo moke, tozali kozala na kopesa prix moke.
examples.note: Condicional ya liboso (if + passé, would/could) ezali na kozala na mikakatí ya hypothese.

examples.original: How about reducing the quantity instead of the price?
examples.phonetic: /haʊ əˈbaʊt rɪˈdjuːsɪŋ ðə ˈkwɒntəti ɪnˈsted əv ðə praɪs/
examples.translation: Ndenge nini na kopesa mokano ya kopesa mokano ya mokuse?
examples.note: 'How about + -ing' ezali na bosongi ya kozala na mikakatí ya alternative.

examples.original: Think of it this way: a lower upfront cost saves you money in the long run.
examples.phonetic: /θɪŋk əv ɪt ðɪs weɪ ə loʊər ʌpˈfrʌnt kɒst seɪvz ju ˈmʌni ɪn ðə lɒŋ rʌn/
examples.translation: Koyeba yango ndenge wana: prix ya mokolo moko ezali na kopesa mbongo mingi na mokolo moke.
examples.note: Mikakatí ya 'Think of it this way' ezali ya solo po na kopesa mokano moke.

examples.original: Would you be open to a trial period for three months?
examples.phonetic: /wʊd ju bi ˈoʊpən tʊ ə ˈtraɪəl ˈpɪəriəd fɔː θriː mʌnθs/
examples.translation: Ozali na mokano ya kozala na mokano ya mokolo moke ya mitano?
examples.note: 'Open to' ezali na mikakatí ya kozala te na español; ezali na kozala na mokano ya kozala na mokano.

examples.original: If we meet your deadline, will you extend the payment terms?
examples.phonetic: /ɪf wi miːt jɔːr dedlaɪn wɪl ju ɪkˈstend ðə ˈpeɪmənt tɜːmz/
examples.translation: Soki tozali kopesa mokano ya mokolo moke, ozali kozala na kopesa mokano ya kopesa mbongo?
examples.note: Condicional ya liboso (if + présent, will) ezali na kozala na mikakatí ya ya solo mpe ezali na kopesa base po na kotsala.

examples.original: I'm confident we can find a solution that works for both sides.
examples.phonetic: /aɪm ˈkɒnfɪdənt wi kæn faɪnd ə səˈluːʃən ðæt wɜːks fɔːr boʊθ saɪdz/
examples.translation: Nazali na elikya ya kozala na mokano ya kozala na bosongi ya biso mibali.
examples.note: Kozala na 'I'm confident' na noko ya 'I think' ezali na kopesa elikya mpe ezali na kosala makasi.

title: Giving and justifying opinions in depth / Komema na kosala mosala ya malamu na makomami
bridge: Na español, ezali kosala ya solo kozonga 'yo creo que' to 'pienso que' mpe kobimisa na 'porque'. Na anglais, po na kosala mosala ya malamu na makomami, ezali mpenza kozonga makomami koleka 'the reason being', 'due to', 'given that', mpe makomami ya kondisionel koleka 'if... then...'. Boya kozonga 'según mi opinión' (ozali kozonga 'according to my opinion' - ezali ya mabe, ezali kozonga 'in my opinion'). Na ndenge ya español, na anglais, verbes modaux (would, could) ezali ya mpenza po na kobatela makomami mpe komonisa makomami ya ndenge nini.
rule: Po na komema makomami na anglais, kozonga: 1) Makomami ya komema: 'In my view', 'From my perspective', 'I would argue that', 'It seems to me that'. 2) Kobimisa: 'The reason for this is', 'This is due to', 'Given that', 'Considering that'. 3) Kosalela: 'However', 'On the other hand', 'While it is true that...', 'Nevertheless'. 4) Kondisionel po na koyeba: 'If... then', 'Unless...', 'Provided that...'. 5) Makomami ya causa-efecto: 'This leads to', 'As a result', 'Consequently'. Niveau B2: Ezali kobebisami kotanga makomami ya komplexe mpe vocabulaire ya abstrait na ndenge ya solo. Kamba na eloko ya pozision ya adverbes ya fréquencia mpe kozonga temps verbal ya solo (present perfect vs. past simple) po na komema exemple.

concept_examples.text: In my view, remote work has increased productivity, the reason being that employees avoid long commutes.
concept_examples.translation: Na nkolo ya ngai, mosala ya loin ekomi na bosembo ya malamu, koma nde komona yango nde bandimi bazali kobimisa makambo ya mbula.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪn maɪ vjuː, rɪˈmoʊt wɜːrk hæz ˈɪnkriːst ˌprɒdʌkˈtɪvəti, ðə ˈriːzn ˈbiːɪŋ ðæt ˌemploʊˈiːz əˈvɔɪd lɔːŋ kəˈmjuːts/

concept_examples.text: I would argue that investing in education yields long-term benefits, given that it improves social mobility.
concept_examples.translation: Nakoti kozonga ete kobenga na eloko ya makasi ekoki kobikisa makomami ya mbula, koma nde komona yango nde ekoki kobimisa mobilité sociale.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd ˈɑːrgjuː ðæt ɪnˈvestɪŋ ɪn ˌedʒuˈkeɪʃn jiːldz lɔːŋ tɜːrm ˈbenɪfɪts, ˈɡɪvn ðæt ɪt ɪmˈpruːvz ˈsoʊʃl moʊˈbɪləti/

concept_examples.text: From my perspective, the new policy is flawed, due to the fact that it ignores regional differences.
concept_examples.translation: Na nkolo ya ngai, politique ya sika ezali na makasi, koma nde komona yango nde ezali kobimisa différence ya région.
concept_examples.phonetic: /frɒm maɪ pərˈspektɪv, ðə nuː ˈpɒləsi ɪz flɔːd, djuː tuː ðə fækt ðæt ɪt ɪɡˈnɔːrz ˈriːdʒənl ˈdɪfrənsɪz/

concept_examples.text: It seems to me that we should prioritize renewable energy, otherwise we will face severe climate consequences.
concept_examples.translation: Nakoti kozonga ete tokoki kobenga yango na eloko ya malamu, kasi tokoki komona makomami ya mabe ya clima.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪt siːmz tuː miː ðæt wiː ʃʊd praɪˈɒrɪtaɪz rɪˈnjuːəbl ˈenərdʒi, ˈʌðəwaɪz wiː wɪl feɪs sɪˈvɪər ˈklaɪmət ˈkɒnsɪkwənsɪz/

common_error.wrong: According to my opinion, the government should do more for education.
common_error.correct: In my opinion, the government should do more for education.
common_error.correct_alt: From my point of view, the government should do more for education.
common_error.explanation: Na español, tozonga 'según mi opinión' (ezali kozonga 'according to my opinion'), kasi na anglais ezali kozonga 'in my opinion' to 'from my point of view'. Erreur wana ezali ya solo na ba espagnol mpo na kozonga 'según' na ndenge ya 'according to'.

examples.original: In my view, the film was overrated.
examples.phonetic: /ɪn maɪ vjuː, ðə fɪlm wɒz ˌoʊvərˈreɪtɪd/
examples.translation: Na nkolo ya ngai, film ezali na ntina ya mabe.
examples.note: Kozonga 'in my view' po na komema makomami ya solo. Tokoki kozonga 'to my mind' (na nkolo ya ngai) kasi ezali ya britannique.

examples.original: I strongly believe that recycling should be mandatory.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ ˈstrɔːŋli bɪˈliːv ðæt rɪˈsaɪklɪŋ ʃʊd biː ˈmændətɔːri/
examples.translation: Nakoti kozonga ete recyclage ezali ya solo.
examples.note: 'Strongly believe' ekoki kobatela makomami; na español tozonga 'creo firmemente'.

examples.original: As far as I'm concerned, the project is on track.
examples.phonetic: /æz fɑːr æz aɪm kənˈsɜːrnd, ðə ˈprɒdʒekt ɪz ɒn træk/
examples.translation: Na nkolo ya ngai, projet ezali na nzela.
examples.note: Expression wana ezali ya solo po na komonisa ete ozali komema makomami ya yo.

examples.original: The reason being that prices have risen significantly.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈriːzn ˈbiːɪŋ ðæt ˈpraɪsɪz hæv ˈrɪzən sɪɡˈnɪfɪkəntli/
examples.translation: Koma nde komona yango nde prix ekomi na ntina ya mabe.
examples.note: Kozonga yango na nsuka ya virgule po na kobimisa makomami ya liboso.

examples.original: Due to the lack of funding, the program was cancelled.
examples.phonetic: /djuː tuː ðə læk ɒv ˈfʌndɪŋ, ðə ˈproʊɡræm wɒz ˈkænsəld/
examples.translation: Koma nde komona yango nde programme ezalaki kobima mpo na mabe ya financement.
examples.note: 'Due to' ezali ya solo kolonga 'because of'. Kamba na 'to' mpe boya kozonga 'because'.

examples.original: Given that the economy is unstable, we should be cautious.
examples.phonetic: /ˈɡɪvn ðæt ði ɪˈkɒnəmi ɪz ʌnˈsteɪbl, wiː ʃʊd biː ˈkɔːʃəs/
examples.translation: Koma nde komona yango nde économie ezali na mabe, tokoki kobimisa yango na makomami.
examples.note: 'Given that' ezali ya solo po na komema kondision to fait ya connu.

examples.original: While it is true that technology has drawbacks, it also opens up new possibilities.
examples.phonetic: /waɪl ɪt ɪz truː ðæt tekˈnɒlədʒi hæz ˈdrɔːbæks, ɪt ˈɔːlsoʊ ˈoʊpənz ʌp nuː ˌpɒsəˈbɪlətiz/
examples.translation: Kasi ezali solo ete technologie ezali na makasi, ezali kozonga ete ezali kobimisa makomami ya sika.
examples.note: Structure wana ekoki komonisa équilibre entre deux idées.

examples.original: Unless we address climate change now, future generations will suffer.
examples.phonetic: /ənˈles wiː əˈdres ˈklaɪmət tʃeɪndʒ naʊ, ˈfjuːtʃər ˌdʒenəˈreɪʃnz wɪl ˈsʌfər/
examples.translation: Kasi tokoki komona yango nde tokoki kobimisa makomami ya sika kasi tokoki komona yango nde bazali kobimisa makomami ya mbula.
examples.note: Kozonga 'unless' na ndenge ya 'a menos que' (kondisionel ya mabe).

examples.original: If the government invested more in healthcare, the overall well-being would improve.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf ðə ˈɡʌvənmənt ɪnˈvestɪd mɔːr ɪn ˈhelθkeər, ði ˌoʊvərˈɔːl ˌwelˈbiːɪŋ wʊd ɪmˈpruːv/
examples.translation: Kasi tokoki komona yango nde gouvernement ekoki kobenga yango na eloko ya malamu, bien-être ya général ekoki komona yango na makomami.
examples.note: Deuxième kondisionel po na hypothèse ya mabe. Na anglais, tozonga passé simple na clause 'if'.

title: Hypothesising about the past / Koyeba ntina na lokola oyo ekomaki
bridge: Na espanyol, po koyeba ntina na lokola oyo ekomaki, tosilanga 'habría + participio' to 'hubiera + participio', kasi na anglais, lisusu ezali moke: basimbololaka 'would have + past participle' po ntina ya makasi mpe 'had + past participle' po ntina ya kondisyon (third conditional). Molongo ya mawa ezali koyekola 'si habría' na 'if would have', kasi na anglais, kondisyon ezwamaka te na 'would'. Kasi, na anglais ezali 'might have' mpe 'could have' po kozonga posa to nguya, oyo na espanyol momasa na 'podría haber' to 'quizás habría'.
rule: Po koyeba ntina na lokola oyo ekomaki na anglais, tosilanga 'third conditional' mpe bangomba ya modal ya makasi. Lisolo ya moko ezali: 'If + past perfect (had + participle), would have + past participle'. Molongo: 'If I had studied, I would have passed'. Basimbololaka mpe bangomba ya modal: 'could have' (nguya to posa), 'might have' (posa), 'should have' (kolakisa to koyeba mawa). Na lisolo ya kozonga to na bangomba ya kolakisa, basimbololaka 'wish + past perfect' (ozali kozela oyo ekomaki). Basimbololaka te 'would have' na bangomba ya 'if'. Na biloko, bosalaka mokolo ya sujet: 'Would you have...?'

concept_examples.text: If I had known, I would have told you.
concept_examples.translation: Soki nazali koyeba yango, nazali koyebisa yo.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ hæd noʊn, aɪ wʊd hæv toʊld juː/

concept_examples.text: She might have missed the train.
concept_examples.translation: Ye azali kozela kotambola na tren.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃiː maɪt hæv mɪst ðə treɪn/

concept_examples.text: We could have won the match.
concept_examples.translation: Biso tozali kozela kopesa likambo.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wiː kʊd hæv wʌn ðə mætʃ/

concept_examples.text: I wish I had studied more.
concept_examples.translation: Nazali kozela naleki mpenza.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ wɪʃ aɪ hæd ˈstʌdɪd mɔːr/

common_error.wrong: If I would have known, I would have told you.
common_error.correct: If I had known, I would have told you.
common_error.correct_alt: Had I known, I would have told you.
common_error.explanation: Molongo oyo ekomi mpo na espanyol basilaka 'Si hubiera sabido' mpe ba étudiants basili 'hubiera' na 'would have', kasi na anglais, kondisyon 'if' ezali na 'would' te. Bosalaka 'had + participle' na bangomba ya kondisyon. Po kozala na mawa, eleki ete 'would' ezali na bangomba ya ntina ya makasi. Molongo moke mpe ya ntina ezali koyekola sujet na 'had': 'Had I known...'.

examples.original: If she had left earlier, she wouldn't have missed the flight.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf ʃiː hæd lɛft ˈɜːrliər, ʃiː ˈwʊdnt hæv mɪst ðə flaɪt/
examples.translation: Soki ye azwaki kopesa likambo, azali kozela kotambola te.
examples.note: Lisolo ya makasi: 'If + past perfect, would not have + participle'.

examples.original: They would have arrived on time if the traffic hadn't been so bad.
examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ wʊd hæv əˈraɪvd ɒn taɪm ɪf ðə ˈtræfɪk ˈhædnt biːn soʊ bæd/
examples.translation: Bango bazali kozela kozala na ntina soki ezali na likambo ya mawa te.
examples.note: Bangomba ya 'if' ezali kozala na nsuka na koma te.

examples.original: You should have called me.
examples.phonetic: /juː ʃʊd hæv kɔːld miː/
examples.translation: Ozali kozela kopesa ngai likambo.
examples.note: Bosalaka 'should have' po koyeba mawa to kolakisa.

examples.original: He could have been a doctor.
examples.phonetic: /hiː kʊd hæv biːn ə ˈdɒktər/
examples.translation: Ye azali kozela kozala dokter.
examples.note: Ezali kozanga nguya to posa ya kozala te.

examples.original: They might have forgotten the meeting.
examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ maɪt hæv fərˈɡɒtn ðə ˈmiːtɪŋ/
examples.translation: Bango bazali kozela kozala na likambo.
examples.note: Ezali kozanga posa ya kozala te na lokola oyo ekomaki.

examples.original: I wish I had accepted the job offer.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wɪʃ aɪ hæd əkˈsɛptɪd ðə dʒɒb ˈɒfər/
examples.translation: Nazali kozela naleki likambo ya mosala.
examples.note: Bosalaka 'wish + past perfect' po koyeba mawa.

examples.original: If only we had listened to the weather forecast.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf ˈoʊnli wiː hæd ˈlɪsənd tuː ðə ˈwɛðər ˈfɔːrkæst/
examples.translation: Nazali kozela tozali koyeba yango.
examples.note: 'If only' ezali lisolo ya ntina ya koyeba mawa.

translations.ln: Koyeba ntina na lokola oyo ekomaki

title: Discussing abstract concepts / Kozonga yango mambu ya makomenu
bridge: Na espanyol, mpo na kozonga mambu ya makomenu, tolingi kotambola na subjonctif ("es importante que...", "creo que sea...") mpe na ba structure ya souplesse. Na anglais, subjonctif ezali na likambo ya limemi mingi: ezali na bango oyo ya verb lokola 'suggest', 'recommend', 'demand', mpe na ba expression lokola 'it is essential that...'. Kuna na anglais, ba nom ya makomenu lokola 'freedom' to 'justice' bazali kotambola na ntango ya kopesa yango na nzela ya makasi, mpe na espanyol tozali kotambola na 'la' ('la libertad'). Boye mpe, na anglais bazali kotambola na auxiliaire 'do' mpo na koposa mpe kobenga, mpe ba adjectif bazali kotambola na sujet.
rule: Mpo na kozonga mambu ya makomenu na anglais na niveau B2, boye ozali na bango: 1. Ba nom ya makomenu na nombe ya nione/ya mibale na 'zero article' mpo na kozonga yango na nzela ya makasi ('Freedom is important' vs 'La libertad es importante'). 2. Ba phrase ya subordination na 'that' + verbe na forme ya mbotama (subjonctif) na nsuka ya ba verbe ya recommandation to ya demande ('I suggest that she be...') mpe na ba adjectif ya makasi ('It is crucial that he attend'). 3. Ba structure mpo na kozonga opinion: 'In my opinion', 'I believe that', 'It seems to me that', na kotambola na indicatif (ezali mbekambe na espanyol oyo tozali kotambola mingi na subjonctif). 4. Ba clause na 'which' mpe 'that' mpo na kobondela mpe kobondela te. 5. Ba verbe modal mpo na kopesa nzela: 'might', 'could', 'would', 'should' mpo na kopesa possibilité, condition to conseil. 6. Ba expression ya impersonnel na 'it' ('It is obvious that', 'It is worth considering'). Boye, na anglais bazali na double négation te, mpe structure ya phrase ezali Sujet + Verbe + Objet.

concept_examples.text: Freedom is not just a political idea, but a personal value.

concept_examples.text: It is essential that we find a balance between progress and tradition.
concept_examples.translation: Ezali ya makasi kopeta équilibre entre progrès mpe tradition.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ɪˈsenʃəl ðæt wiː faɪnd ə ˈbæləns bɪˈtwiːn ˈprəʊɡres ænd trəˈdɪʃən/

concept_examples.text: I believe that happiness depends more on our attitude than on our circumstances.
concept_examples.translation: Nakoki koloba ete bonheur ezali na rapport na attitude na biso mingi koleka na ba circonstance na biso.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ bɪˈliːv ðæt ˈhæpɪnəs dɪˈpendz mɔːr ɒn aʊər ˈætɪtjuːd ðæn ɒn aʊə ˈsɜːkəmstænsɪz/

concept_examples.translation: Bato mingi bazali koloba ete succès ezali na rapport na satisfaction, kasi ezali mpe na rapport na stress.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈmeni ˈpiːpl θɪŋk ðæt səkˈses brɪŋz ˌsætɪsˈfækʃən bət ɪt meɪ ˈɔːlsəʊ kriˈeɪt stres/

common_error.wrong: It is important that we will respect the environment.
common_error.correct: It is important that we respect the environment.
common_error.correct_alt: It is important that we should respect the environment.
common_error.explanation: Seki ya mawa: kotambola 'will' na nsuka ya ba expression lokola 'it is important that' mpo na espanyol tozali kotambola na subjonctif ya nsuka ('será importante que respetemos'). Na anglais, na nsuka ya ba adjectif mpe ba verbe oyo, bazali kotambola na subjonctif ya présent (forme ya mbotama ya verbe) to, mingi, 'should' + infinitif. Kotambola 'will' na phrase oyo ezali soki.

levels.label: Using abstract nouns with zero article
levels.translation: Kotambola ba nom ya makomenu na article te

examples.original: Love is a universal feeling.
examples.phonetic: /lʌv ɪz ə ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːsəl ˈfiːlɪŋ/
examples.translation: Amour ezali sentiment ya mawa.
examples.note: Na anglais, bazali kobenga article ya définition mpo na kozonga ba concept na nzela ya makasi, mbekambe na espanyol oyo tozali kotambola na 'el' to 'la'.

examples.original: Honesty is the best policy.
examples.phonetic: /ˈɒnɪsti ɪz ðə best ˈpɒləsi/
examples.translation: Honnêteté ezali politique ya mawa.
examples.note: Mbala mpe, na anglais bazali kobenga article mpo na concept ya makasi.

examples.original: Wealth doesn't guarantee happiness.
examples.phonetic: /welθ ˈdʌzənt ˌɡærənˈtiː ˈhæpɪnəs/
examples.translation: Richesse ezali te garantie ya bonheur.
examples.note: Tala na auxiliaire 'doesn't' mpo na kobenga na présent simple.

levels.label: Subjunctive after impersonal expressions
levels.translation: Subjonctif na nsuka ya ba expression ya impersonnel

examples.original: It is vital that she be informed before the meeting.
examples.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈvaɪtəl ðæt ʃiː biː ɪnˈfɔːmd bɪˈfɔː ðə ˈmiːtɪŋ/
examples.translation: Ezali ya makasi yango azali na informations liboso ya réunion.
examples.note: Kuna tozali kotambola na forme ya mbotama 'be' na esika 'is'; na espanyol tozali kotambola 'sea' (subjonctif).

examples.original: The committee proposes that the rules be changed.
examples.phonetic: /ðə kəˈmɪti prəˈpəʊzɪz ðæt ðə ruːlz biː tʃeɪndʒd/
examples.translation: Comité ezali koposa ete ba règles bazali kobongwana.
examples.note: Na 'propose' mpe ba verbe naye ya recommandation, verbe ya subordination ezali na forme ya mbotama.

examples.original: It is necessary that everyone participate in the discussion.
examples.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈnesəsəri ðæt ˈevriwʌn pɑːˈtɪsɪpeɪt ɪn ðə dɪˈskʌʃən/
examples.translation: Ezali ya makasi ete nionso bazali na discussion.
examples.note: Subjonctif: 'participate' (te 'participates').

levels.label: Qualifying opinions with modals and hedging
levels.translation: Kopesa nzela na ba opinion na ba modal mpe langue ya prudence

examples.original: One could argue that technology is making us more isolated.
examples.phonetic: /wʌn kʊd ˈɑːɡjuː ðæt tekˈnɒlədʒi ɪz ˈmeɪkɪŋ ʌs mɔːr ˈaɪsəleɪtɪd/
examples.translation: Tokoki koloba ete technologie ezali kopesa biso iso mpe iso.
examples.note: 'Could' tozali kotambola mpo na kopesa possibilité mpe kopesa souplesse na opinion.

examples.original: It might be true that freedom requires responsibility.
examples.phonetic: /ɪt maɪt biː truː ðæt ˈfriːdəm rɪˈkwaɪəz rɪˌspɒnsəˈbɪləti/
examples.translation: Ezali possible ete libreté ezali na rapport na responsabilité.
examples.note: Kotambola 'might' mpo na possibilité mpe prudence.

examples.original: That seems to be a reasonable point, though some would disagree.
examples.phonetic: /ðæt siːmz tə bi ə ˈriːzənəbl pɔɪnt ðəʊ sʌm wʊd ˌdɪsəˈɡriː/
examples.translation: Yango ezali point ya raison, kasi bato moko bazali na accord te.
examples.note: Kotambola 'would' mpo na conditionnel mpe 'though' mpo na kopesa concession.

title: Expressing complex emotions / Komona bosɔ́li ya makasi na makasi
bridge: Na espanyole, tozali kosalela mpé ve na ba adjectif kaka 'estar' to 'sentirse' po komona bosɔ́li, kasi na ngala tozali kosalela ba structure moko malamu, kaka ba adjectif mibɔ́kɔ, ba phrases na ba prépositions mpe ba ngogo ya lokuta. Molongo ya mawa ele makasi ezali kopesa 'tengo miedo de' kaka 'I have fear of' na ngala ya 'I'm afraid of'. Mpe na ngala tozali kobakisa makasi oyo espanyole akokoki kobakisa na ba mot ya moko, kaka 'frustrated' (frustrado) na 'annoyed' (molesto), to 'overwhelmed' (abrumado) oyo esili ndako ya solo na espanyole. Boye mpe koyeba na ba prépositions mpe na ba adjectif oyo bazali kobimisa ndako na bango na préposition.
rule: Po komona bosɔ́li ya makasi na ngala, tosalela mpé ve: 1) Ba adjectif na ba prépositions ya solo: 'angry about/at', 'frustrated with', 'disappointed in/with', 'excited about', 'worried about', 'ashamed of', 'proud of'. 2) Ba structures na 'feel' + adjectif to 'feel like' + gerund po bosɔ́li ya ndɔ́kɔ. 3) Ba verbes kaka 'get' + adjectif po bokambi ya bosɔ́li (get frustrated, get overwhelmed). 4) Ba adjectif mibɔ́kɔ na trait d'union po bosɔ́li ya makasi: 'homesick', 'heartbroken', 'overwhelmed'. 5) Ba ngogo po bosɔ́li ya makasi: 'on cloud nine' (na likambo ya mawa), 'down in the dumps' (na likambo ya mabé). Koyeba ete 'nervous' ezali po kozala na stress, 'anxious' ekoki koteya kozala na likambo ya mawa ya makasi; 'upset' ezali makasi mingi na 'sad'. Kotiya kosalela 'I have' na bosɔ́li na ngala, boye mpe na ba expressions kaka 'I have a feeling'.

concept_examples.text: I feel overwhelmed by all these responsibilities.
concept_examples.translation: Nazali na bosɔ́li ya makasi na likambo ya bankolo ya ngai nyonso.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ fiːl ˌoʊvərˈwɛlmd baɪ ɔːl ðiːz rɪˌspɑːnsəˈbɪlətiz/

concept_examples.text: She's disappointed with her exam results.
concept_examples.translation: Alingaka na makasi na likambo ya ba résultat ya examen ya ye.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃiːz ˌdɪsəˈpɔɪntɪd wɪð hɜːr ɪɡˈzæm rɪˈzʌlts/

concept_examples.text: He's excited about his trip to Japan.
concept_examples.translation: Azali na mawa na likambo ya voyage ya ye na Japon.
concept_examples.phonetic: /hiːz ɪkˈsaɪtɪd əˈbaʊt hɪz trɪp tə dʒəˈpæn/

concept_examples.text: They were heartbroken when they heard the news.
concept_examples.translation: Bazalaki na likambo ya mabé na tango bayokaki yango.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ wɜːr ˈhɑːrtbroʊkən wɛn ðeɪ hɜːrd ðə nuːz/

common_error.correct_alt: I have a fear of flying.

examples.original: I'm annoyed with my brother.
examples.phonetic: /aɪm əˈnɔɪd wɪð maɪ ˈbrʌðər/
examples.translation: Nazali na likambo ya mabé na ndeko na ngai.
examples.note: Tosalela 'annoyed with' po ba ndeko mpe 'annoyed at/about' po ba situations.

examples.original: She's worried about her health.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiːz ˈwɜːrid əˈbaʊt hɜːr hɛlθ/
examples.translation: Azali na likambo ya mabé na sante ya ye.
examples.note: Tosalela 'worried about', kasi 'worried of' te.

examples.phonetic: /wɪr ɪkˈsaɪtɪd əˈbaʊt ðə ˈkɑːnsərt/
examples.translation: Tozali na mawa na likambo ya concert.
examples.note: Koyeba ete 'excited' ezali na ndako ya mawa.

examples.original: I feel anxious about the job interview.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ fiːl ˈæŋkʃəs əˈbaʊt ðə dʒɑːb ˈɪntərvjuː/
examples.translation: Nazali na likambo ya mabé na likambo ya entretien ya travail.

examples.note: Tosalela 'feel like' + gerund po ba désirs to ba impulsions ya bosɔ́li.

examples.original: I feel frustrated with this project.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ fiːl ˈfrʌstreɪtɪd wɪð ðɪs ˈprɒdʒekt/
examples.translation: Nazali na likambo ya mabé na projet oyo.
examples.note: Préposition ezali 'with' tango otalela ba choses to ba situations.

levels.label: Compound adjectives and idiomatic expressions
levels.translation: Ba adjectif mibɔ́kɔ mpe ba expressions ya ngogo

examples.original: He felt homesick during his first month abroad.
examples.phonetic: /hiː fɛlt ˈhoʊmsɪk ˈdjʊrɪŋ hɪz fɜːrst mʌnθ əˈbrɔːd/
examples.translation: Azalaki na likambo ya mabé na mois ya ye ya liboso na pays moko.
examples.note: Ndako ya solo ezali na espanyole; 'homesick' ezali kopesa ndako ya ye.

examples.phonetic: /ʃiː wəz ˈoʊvər ðə muːn əˈbaʊt hɜːr prəˈmoʊʃn/
examples.translation: Azalaki na mawa ya makasi na likambo ya promotion ya ye.
examples.note: Expression ya ngogo po mawa ya makasi.

examples.original: He was down in the dumps after the breakup.
examples.phonetic: /hiː wəz daʊn ɪn ðə dʌmps ˈæftər ðə ˈbreɪkʌp/
examples.translation: Azalaki na likambo ya mabé na tango ya rupture.

title: Formal Writing: Reports and Emails / Ekoti ya likebi na email
bridge: Na español, ekoti ya likebi ekomela kopesa makambo mingi na kozonga mikanda mifuke na mikanda mifuke. Na anglais, likebi ekomela na elongo na bosembo na kozonga makambo na ntango feni. Molongo moko mwa mabe ezali kozonga 'Le adjunto' na 'I attach' (mabe) kasi 'Please find attached' to 'I have attached'. Kasi na anglais ya likebi, bato basali na verbes modales lokola 'would' na 'could' mpo na bosembo, kasi na español basali na 'condicional de cortesía' ('Podría'). Molongo moko mpenza: na anglais basali te na 'usted' to na makanda mamasoli ya bosembo, kasi basali na ndakisa ya makambo mamasoli na mikanda mifuke.
rule: Mpo na kosala raporo na email na anglais na niveau B2, ezali mpenza kozala na elongo na: 1) Makanda ya kosalema na kobenga: 'Dear Mr. Smith', 'Dear Madam', 'Yours sincerely', 'Yours faithfully'. 2) Verbes na mikanda ya likebi: 'state' (kasi te 'say'), 'require' (kasi te 'need'), 'I would like to' (kasi te 'I want'), 'I am writing to inform you'. 3) Makanda ya mikanda: mwanda moko ya kosalema, mokili na makambo mamasoli, na mwanda moko ya kosala na kopesa makambo. 4) Kozala te na kozonga makambo: sala 'do not' kasi te 'don't', 'I would' kasi te 'I'd'. 5) Mpo na raporo: sala makanda mamasoli lokola 'Introduction', 'Findings', 'Recommendations', na ndakisa ya makambo mamasoli lokola 'It was found that...' (Bakomi na kozala...). 6) Verbes modales mpo na bosembo: 'Could you please...', 'I would appreciate...', 'Would it be possible to...?'. Kosala ete na anglais ya likebi basali te na 'please' na mawa ya mwanda (ezali mpe na ndakisa ya makambo mamasoli), kasi basali na mawa to na mawa ya verbe.

concept_examples.text: I am writing to inform you that the quarterly report has been completed.
concept_examples.translation: Nazali kosalema yo mpo na kopesa yo yango ete raporo ya mois ezali kosala.
concept_examples.phonetic: aɪ æm ˈraɪtɪŋ tuː ɪnˈfɔːm juː ðæt ðə ˈkwɔːtəli rɪˈpɔːt hæz biːn kəmˈpliːtɪd.

concept_examples.text: Please find attached the requested documents for your review.
concept_examples.translation: Ozali na yango mikanda oyo bazali na kopesa yo mpo na kosala yango.
concept_examples.phonetic: pliːz faɪnd əˈtætʃt ðə rɪˈkwestɪd ˈdɒkjʊmənts fɔː jɔː rɪˈvjuː.

concept_examples.text: I would be grateful if you could provide us with further details.
concept_examples.translation: Nazali na kopesa yo yango ete ozali na kopesa biso makambo mingi.
concept_examples.phonetic: aɪ wʊd biː ˈɡreɪtfʊl ɪf juː kʊd prəˈvaɪd ʌs wɪð ˈfɜːðə ˈdiːteɪlz.

concept_examples.text: Yours sincerely, John Smith
concept_examples.translation: Na bosembo, John Smith
concept_examples.phonetic: jɔːz sɪnˈsɪəli, dʒɒn smɪθ.

common_error.wrong: I am writing to complaint about the service.
common_error.correct: I am writing to complain about the service.
common_error.correct_alt: I am writing to express my dissatisfaction with the service.
common_error.explanation: Molongo ezali kozala na 'complaint' (nomo) kasi te 'complain' (verbe) na nsima ya 'to'. Na español, 'queja' ezali kozala na nomo, kasi na anglais basali na verbe 'complain'. Molongo moko mwa mabe ezali kozonga 'me quejo de' na 'I complain of' kasi na ndakisa ezali 'I complain about'. Mpo na kozala te na yango, kosala ete na nsima ya 'to' basali na verbe na ntango ya kozala: 'to complain'.

examples.original: Dear Sir or Madam,
examples.phonetic: dɪə sɜːr ɔːr ˈmædəm,
examples.translation: Nzote ya Monsieur to Madame,
examples.note: Ezali kozala na yango mpo na kozala te na kozala na nomo ya moyibi. Na español basali na 'Estimado/a señor/a', kasi na anglais basali mingi na 'Dear Sir or Madam'.

examples.original: Dear Ms. García,
examples.phonetic: dɪə mɪz ɡɑːrˈsiːə,
examples.translation: Nzote ya Madame García,
examples.note: Na anglais, 'Ms.' ezali ya mawa na ezali te kozala na kozala na mawa ya kozala, kasi 'Señora' ezali kozala na mawa ya kozala. Kozala te na 'Mrs.' kasi ozali na kozala ete azali na kozala.

examples.original: Yours faithfully,
examples.phonetic: jɔːz ˈfeɪθfʊli,
examples.translation: Na bosembo (soki ozali te na kozala na nomo)
examples.note: Ezali kozala na yango mpo na kozala na 'Dear Sir or Madam'. Na español basali na 'Atentamente' na mikanda mibiri, kasi na anglais basali na 'Yours faithfully' mpo na kosalema ya mawa na 'Yours sincerely' mpo na nomo oyo bazali na kozala.

examples.original: Yours sincerely,
examples.phonetic: jɔːz sɪnˈsɪəli,
examples.translation: Na bosembo (soki ozali na kozala na nomo)
examples.note: Ezali kozala na yango mpo na kozala na 'Dear Mr. Smith'. Kosala ete 'sincerely' ezali na 'c', kasi te na 'z' lokola na español 'sinceramente'.

levels.label: Polite Requests and Inquiries
levels.translation: Makambo ya kozala na kopesa na bosembo

examples.original: Could you please send me the updated schedule?
examples.phonetic: kʊd juː pliːz send miː ðiː ʌpˈdeɪtɪd ˈʃedjuːl?
examples.translation: Ozali na kopesa ngai mokolo oyo bazali na kozala?
examples.note: Na anglais ya likebi, 'Could you please' ezali mpe na bosembo mingi koleka 'Can you'. Na español basali na 'Podría' oyo ezali ya mawa.

examples.original: I would appreciate your response at your earliest convenience.
examples.phonetic: aɪ wʊd əˈpriːʃieɪt jɔː rɪˈspɒns æt jɔː ˈɜːlɪəst kənˈviːniəns.
examples.translation: Nazali na kopesa yo yango ete ozali na kopesa ngai likambo na ntango feni.
examples.note: Ndakisa ya mikanda ezali ya mawa mingi na ezali kozala na anglais ya likebi. Na español ezali ya mawa: 'agradecería su respuesta tan pronto como sea posible'.

examples.original: Would it be possible to schedule a meeting next week?
examples.phonetic: wʊd ɪt biː ˈpɒsəbəl tə ˈʃedjuːl ə ˈmiːtɪŋ nekst wiːk?
examples.translation: Ozali na kozala na mokolo moko na nsima ya siki?
examples.note: Ndakisa ya mikanda na 'would' ezali ya mawa mingi. Na español, 'sería posible' ezali ya mawa, kasi na anglais basali mingi na 'es posible'.

levels.label: Structuring Reports and Summaries
levels.translation: Makanda ya raporo na mikanda ya kozala

examples.original: The purpose of this report is to analyze the sales data for the third quarter.
examples.phonetic: ðə ˈpɜːpəs əv ðɪs rɪˈpɔːt ɪz tə ˈænəlaɪz ðə seɪlz ˈdeɪtə fɔː ðə θɜːd ˈkwɔːtə.
examples.translation: Mpo na raporo ezali mpo na kosala makambo ya kozala ya mois ya tris.
examples.note: Na anglais ya likebi basali na 'the purpose of this report is to...' mpo na kopesa mwa. Na español basali na 'El propósito de este informe es...' kasi basali mingi na 'El objetivo de este informe...'.

examples.original: It was found that customer satisfaction has increased by 15%.
examples.phonetic: ɪt wɒz faʊnd ðæt ˈkʌstəmər ˌsætɪsˈfækʃən hæz ɪnˈkriːst baɪ fɪfˈtiːn pəˈsent.
examples.translation: Bakomi na kozala ete bosembo ya klienti ezali na kopesa 15%.
examples.note: Na anglais ya likebi basali na mawa ya mawa na 'it was found that...' mpo na kozala te na kozala oyo akomi na kozala. Na español, basali na 'se encontró que' oyo ezali ya mawa.

examples.original: Based on the findings, we recommend implementing a new training program.
examples.phonetic: beɪst ɒn ðə ˈfaɪndɪŋz, wiː ˌrekəˈmend ˈɪmplɪməntɪŋ ə njuː ˈtreɪnɪŋ ˈprəʊɡræm.
examples.translation: Na mwa na yango, nazali na kopesa yango ete tokosala mikanda mifuke ya kozala.
examples.note: Na anglais, 'recommend + gerund' (nazali na kopesa yango) ezali ya mawa. Na español, basali na 'recomendamos implementar' oyo ezali na ntango ya kozala. Kozala te na kozala na 'recommend to implement' na anglais ya likebi; kasi ezali ya mawa, 'recommend implementing' ezali ya mawa mingi.

examples.original: In conclusion, the project was delivered on time and within budget.
examples.phonetic: ɪn kənˈkluːʒən, ðə ˈprɒdʒekt wɒz dɪˈlɪvəd ɒn taɪm ənd wɪðɪn ˈbʌdʒɪt.
examples.translation: Na mawa, mikanda ezali na mokolo na na ntango ya kozala.
examples.note: Ndakisa ya mikanda 'in conclusion' ezali ya mawa na ezali kozala mpo na kobenga. Na español, 'en conclusión' ezali ya mawa kasi basali mingi na 'para concluir'.

title: Dealing with Conflict / Kanga malamu na mabe na maloba oyo ezali na makasi
bridge: Na español, tozali kozua kotosa na imperativo mpe na ba constructions oyo ezali na 'deberías' mpo na kosilisa makasi. Kasi na anglais, biloko oyo ezali na nguya mpe oyo ezali na elongo ezali ya motuya mingi: tozali kozua ba verbos modales lokola 'could' mpe 'might', mpe ba phrases lokola 'I feel...' na esika ya ba accusations mabe. Mabe oyo tozali kozua mingi ezali kopesa 'tienes que' lokola 'you must', oyo ezali na nguya mingi; na esika na yango, tozali kozua 'you might want to' to 'maybe you could'.
rule: Mpo na kanga malamu na mabe na anglais na niveau B2, tozali kozua ba stratégies ya nguya mpe ya langue oyo ezali na elongo. Ba ressources ya motuya ezali: 1) Ba verbos modales mpo na ba suggestions oyo ezali na elongo: 'could', 'might', 'would' (lokola 'We could try...'). 2) Ba expressions ya opinion ya motema na 'I feel', 'I think', 'I believe' mpo na kobenga ba accusations. 3) Ba structures ya condition mpo na kopesa ba solutions: 'If you..., we could...'. 4) Ba phrases mpo na komonisa empatie: 'I understand', 'I see your point'. 5) Ba questions oyo ezali na elongo: 'I wonder if you could...'. 6) Kozua 'sorry' mpo na koloba ndimbi na kozua elongo na kozua elongo: 'I'm sorry if that came across the wrong way'. Benga kozua imperativo mpe ba accusations na 'you' (lokola 'You are wrong') mpo na yango ezali na nguya. Na esika na yango, kozua 'I'm not sure that's accurate' to 'I see it differently'.

title: Summarising and Paraphrasing / Kokanisa na koparafráza
bridge: Na español, tozali koparafráza na kozonga mpo na lokuta 'o sea', 'es decir' na 'en resumen', kasi na anglais, banani batiki bangonga ya kopesa ndambu ya komona na ndambu ya mokolo na kopesa makomi na liyeba ya mobali to na mokolo ya mobali. Ewumeli: na anglais, basili kotambola 'in summary' mpo na 'in short' to 'to sum up', na 'summarize' ezali na eloko moko mpe na ntina ya mokolo ya mibale. Mpo na eloko moko, na español tozali kotambola na kopesa ndambu ya komona, kasi na anglais, kotambola na kopesa ndambu ya komona ezali na eloko moko mpe na ntina ya mokolo ya mibale, kasi ezali na eloko moko mpe na ntina ya mokolo ya mibale.
rule: Mpo na kokani na koparafráza na anglais na niveau B2, tozali kotambola na verbes mpo na 'summarize', 'paraphrase', 'outline', 'restate', na mabanga mpo na 'in other words', 'that is', 'to put it briefly', 'in a nutshell', 'to sum up', 'in short', 'all in all' na 'to recap'. Structure ya ntina ezali: [Conector] + [cláusula na ndambu ya kokani]. Mpo na koparafráza, tozali kotambola na structure ya grammaire (mpo na ndakisa, na voix active na passive, to na cláusula subordinada na phrase nominal) kasi tozali kotambola na ndambu ya kokani. Ndakisa: 'The study reveals a significant increase...' → 'In other words, the numbers went up a lot.' Mpo na kokani texte, tozali kotambola na 'The text is about...' to 'The author argues that...'. Tosengeli kotambola 'en resumen' mpo na 'in summary' na contexte ya mawa; kopesa 'in short' to 'to sum up'. Ewumeli mpe na kotambola 'actually' (ezali mpo na 'en realidad', kasi 'actualmente'), kasi na kokani tozali kotambola 'in fact' to 'actually' na ntina ya ntina.

title: Using Idioms Naturally / Kozwa míkénsá ya lokóta na ntólo
bridge: Na lingála, míkénsá ya lokóta ezali mbongo mpenza mpe mbala nyingi ezali kosalema na bankango oyo ezali na nsé oyo ete 'kótá' to 'kóma' (p. ex., 'kóma oyo ekómi ndaku'). Na anglais, míkénsá mingi ezali kotóngama na bankango ya komema mpe na zola ya mbongo, mpe mbala nyingi ezali makasi mpe na ntólo. Molóngi moko ezali kozonga míkénsá ya lingála na anglais (p. ex., 'kótá molóngi moko' na esika ya 'kozala na molóngi moko'). Kuna na anglais, ezali kosalema mbala nyingi na bankango 'to be' na mikolo oyo ete 'be over the moon', mpe na lingála ezali kosalema 'kóma' to 'kótá'. Koluka kotánga motuya: míkénsá misusu ezali ya ntólo moke ('kick the bucket') mpe mosusu ezali ya ntólo moke te ('pass away').
rule:
Koyeba kozwa míkénsá ya anglais na ntólo, zonga banzuzi yango:
1. Koyeba míkénsá oyo ezali na ntólo, te kozonga bankango na bankango.
2. Koyeba motuya: ya ntólo moke, ya ntólo moke te, ya koti to ya mbala. P. ex., 'to be over the moon' ezali ya ntólo moke, kasi 'to be delighted' ezali ya ntólo moke te.
3. Míkénsá mingi ezali na nsé oyo ekómí na bankango. P. ex.: 'break the ice' ezali kozonga kozonga mbula, kasi kozala na nsé ya kozala na nsé ya kozala na nsé.
4. Ezali mbala nyingi na nsé ya kozala na nsé, kasi na yambo to na yambo ya kozala na nsé ezali kozala na ntólo.
5. Míkénsá misusu ezali na mikolo ya mbula (p. ex., 'to be in hot water' na anglais ya ameriki vs. 'to be in a pickle' na mibali mibali).
6. Koyeba mpe kozala na nsé: míkénsá mbala nyingi ezali kozala na nsé ya kozala na nsé, mpe mikolo ezali mbala nyingi na nsé ya kozala na nsé (p. ex., 'it's raining cats and dogs').
7. Míkénsá moko te ezali ya bankango; misusu ezali mikolo ya zola to ya nsé (p. ex., 'a piece of cake' = oyo ezali ya mbongo).
8. Koyeba mikolo ya bankango: míkénsá mingi ezali kozala na mikolo ya mbula (p. ex., 'he bit the bullet'), koyeba kozala na mikolo ya mbula.

title: Academic and Professional Register / Mokolo ya makomi na ya miko
bridge: Na ngala ya makomi na ya miko, mbula na bokasi basili na likambo ya kozonga mbala na kozonga mambu na banyoki, na banzelaka ya kopesa na banyoki ya mambu ya kopesa, kasi na lingala ya español basili na kozonga mbala na kozonga mambu na banyoki ya mambu ya kopesa. Nsango moko ya mawa ya moyebi ya español ezali kopesa mbala na mbala na banyoki ya mambu ya kopesa ('It is said that...' → 'Se dice que...') na kozala na bongo na mokolo ya ngala ya inglés ezali na nyonso ya kopesa mbala na mbala na banyoki ya mambu ya kopesa to na banyoki ya mambu ya kopesa. Ezali mpe na likambo ya kozala na 'would', 'could' na 'might' na kozala na mambu ya kopesa, likambo moko na español ezali na 'podría ser' kasi na ngala ya inglés ezali na nyonso ya kopesa mbala na mbala na banyoki ya mambu ya kopesa. Boya kozala na mambu ya kopesa: 'can' na 'will' ezali na mambu ya kopesa, kasi na mokolo ya makomi na ya miko basali na 'may' na 'would'.
rule: Na ngala ya makomi na ya miko ya mawa, basali na kozonga mbala na kozonga mambu na banyoki ya mambu ya kopesa ('It was decided...') na kozala na banyoki ya mambu ya kopesa ('We decided...') na kozala na banyoki ya mambu ya kopesa. Banzelaka ya kopesa ('may', 'might', 'could') basali na kopesa mambu ya kopesa, na 'would' na kozala na mambu ya kopesa. Banyoki ya kopesa (kozonga banzelaka na banyoki, e.g., 'to decide' → 'decision') ezali na mambu ya kopesa na mambu ya kopesa. Na nyonso ya kozonga mbala, basali na banyoki ya kopesa (don't → do not), na basali na banyoki ya kopesa na mambu ya kopesa. Na mabanga, ngala ya español ya mawa ezali na kozonga mbala na kozonga mambu na banyoki ya mambu ya kopesa, kasi na ngala ya inglés ezali na nyonso ya kopesa mbala na mbala na banyoki ya mambu ya kopesa (eta na banyoki ya kopesa) na nyonso ya kozonga mbala ezali na mambu ya kopesa. Na B2, boye kozala na kozonga mbala na banyoki ya kopesa, banzelaka ya kopesa na mokolo na mokolo ('could have done'), na kozala na 'would' na banyoki ya kopesa.

common_error.correct: It is said that the problem is easy to solve.
common_error.correct_alt: People say the problem is easy to solve.
common_error.explanation: Nsango moko ezali kopesa mbala na mbala 'Se dice que...' na 'It says that...' to 'Se says that...' na kozala na banyoki ya mambu ya kopesa 'It is said that...'. Na español, banyoki ya kopesa na 'se' ezali na mambu ya kopesa, kasi na ngala ya inglés ezali na 'It + banyoki ya kopesa' to 'People/They' na kopesa mbala. Boya kozala na 'Se says' (kozala na español) na kosala na banyoki ya kopesa ezali na banzelaka 'to be' + banyoki ya kopesa, na 'It' na kopesa mbala.
